summary: Bootstrap monag delivery with adopted wellmanifest governance and repository-owned project files

delivery.outcome: Adopt wellmanifest/new-project 0.20.30 as one verified bootstrap with the repository-owned governance manifest, required checks, ticket allocation, VERSION, CHANGELOG, README, package metadata and checkout-scoped Goal configuration, so the monag CLI can be delivered through governed dependent tickets.
nonGoals: No CLI source, tests, packaging extras, documentation tree or resume inventory in this slice.
No self-approved merge or direct production policy changes.
No recording of secret environment values or agent prompt contents.

architecture.decision: Adopt immutable managed governance as one verified bootstrap and keep repository-owned project metadata in the same integration slice; deliver product code through dependent tickets.
interfaceChanges: Repository commits and pull requests are governed by the adopted host contract and gate.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bootstrap through the protected publication process; dependent tickets must be reverted first.

validation.evidence: Atomic adoption verifies against the lock; intent, scope and budget are valid.
Host files and the pre-commit hook are active for this clone.
